hypotheses.justification: After introducing hV, recover hB as (Complex.norm_nonneg (V 0)).trans (hV 0), then use the existing proof unchanged. The earlier construction of U₀ does not require hB. Negative B makes hV impossible; B = 0 is covered. Both hB and hBT can be deleted together.

After introducing hT, recover hBT as (Complex.norm_nonneg (T 0)).trans (hT 0), then use the existing proof unchanged. The earlier construction of U₀ does not require hBT. Negative BT makes hT impossible, and zero causes no exception. Both hB and hBT can be deleted together.
